title: Red Hat Security Advisory: openssh security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been identified and fixed in OpenSSH as distributed by Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9. These include information disclosure via a shared compression side-channel, arbitrary file write through directory traversal during SFTP recursive copy, credential disclosure via failed GSSAPI authentication, denial of service via oversized decompressed packets, and command injection via unvalidated command-line username. Red Hat has released an update addressing these issues with a moderate security impact rating.
